task: Immunosenescence classification (younger vs older immune profile)
model: SelectKBest(f_classif, k=25) -> LogisticRegression(C=0.01) on GPL15207 gene expression
input: whole-blood expression vector in the GPL15207 probe schema (~49k probes), per-cohort z-scored
note: Trained on year-2015 cohort; externally validated only on individuals absent from training (GSE123696/697 are the same longitudinal study). Per-cohort z-scoring is required to correct batch effects across datasets.
